description.value:
Legend traces the Bloodstorm Approach back to the wookiee Hroufrasnooohn clan, warriors who performed impossible aerial feats with their vibroaxes through a blend of unorthodox training and sheer belief in their own skill. Their name, roughly translated, means exactly what their fighting style looks like: a storm of blood.

A berserker who inherits this tradition hurls their weapons with such precision and force that the distinction between melee and ranged combat all but disappears — every throw lands like a blow struck at arm's length.
